title: Law to require reporting on minority- and women-owned subcontractors
summary: This bill would require contractors on city human services contracts to disclose to the contracting agency within 30 days when they hire a certified minority- or women-owned business as a subcontractor, including the subcontractor's contact information and the value and type of work. Agencies would have to forward these disclosures to the Mayor's Office of Contract Services by October 31 each year for subcontracts executed or amended during the prior fiscal year. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
